author: PlayStation
description:
The Gran Turismo World Series 2026 Season is about to begin. Starting with Milan, the drivers will go head-to-head across three rounds before heading into the World Finals.

A total of 12 drivers will compete in the Nations Cup, made up of three seeded drivers who topped the rankings last year, and nine drivers selected from the top of the Online Qualifiers. Seeds Jose Serrano, Takuma Miyazono, and Pol Urra are all well known for their racing skills, but they'll be up against some serious competition.

Last year's champion Serrano has admitted himself, the level of competition in the Nations Cup is increasing every season. So who will stand on the first podium of the 2026 Series?

A separate Live Timing stream where viewers can check position changes, sector times, and other race statistics in real-time is also available. We hope you'll enjoy this new feature:
https://youtube.com/live/omNpir6t0Rw

#ps5 #ps5games #granturismo7
title: GT World Series 2026 | Round 1 - Milan | Nations Cup [English]

author: PlayStation
description:
The opening round of the 'Gran Turismo World Series' 2026 will bring the action to Milan for its first ever live event. 

A total of 12 teams, including the Official Partners Toyota and Mazda, plus the manufacturers that qualified at the top of the rankings in the Online Qualifiers will compete in the Manufacturers Cup live events. This time, the competitors selected from the Americas Region will be representing their team.

The season's first round sees an overhaul for the roster with veterans changing teams, and new talent on the field. There will be some new cars for some of the manufacturers as well. With so many unknown factors, it's impossible to tell where this year will take us.

Will the powerhouse manufacturers like last season's champions Porsche manage to pull off another solid victory? Or will chaos reign over the opening round? This race will set the tone for the whole Series ahead, so don't miss it.

6月2日（火）、「State of Play」が帰ってきます。世界中のトップスタジオによる最新情報、発表、ゲームプレイ映像などを、60分以上にわたってお届けします。

番組の幕開けを飾るのは『Marvel’s Wolverine』の最新映像。Insomniac Gamesが手がける三人称視点アクションアドベンチャーの最新作について、ローガンの容赦のない激しい戦闘を披露するとともに、新情報も公開します。コミック界の伝説的キャラクターをまったく新たに描いた本作は、9月15日（火）にPS5で発売予定。

「State of Play」のライブ配信は、6月2日（火）午後2時（PT）／午後5時（ET）／午後11時（CEST）| 6月3日（水）午前6時（JST）に、YouTube およびTwitchでご覧いただけます。配信は英語音声で、日本語字幕にも対応しています。ぜひご視聴ください。

author: PlayStation
description:
State of Play returns Tuesday, June 2 with more than 60 minutes of updates, announcements, and gameplay reveals from top studios around the world. 

To kick things off, you’ll get a closer look at Marvel’s Wolverine. Insomniac Games will share more from its upcoming third-person action-adventure game showing off Logan’s brutal and relentless combat along with some new details. This all-new take on the comic book legend launches on PS5 September 15.

Watch the State of Play broadcast live Tuesday, June 2 at 2:00pm PT / 5:00pm ET / 11:00pm CEST | June 3 at 6:00am JST on YouTube and Twitch. The broadcast will be in English, with Japanese subtitles also available. We hope to see you then!
